premise: Rain comes in three sizes, tiny, medium and big, fills every puddle, and then the sun comes out and drinks the puddles up one by one.
inspiration: Three-sizes folk motif (Goldilocks), turned into weather with a counting refrain the child can say along.
lesson: Everything has its turn: the rain to fill, the sun to dry.
learning: Rain fills puddles and the sun dries them up again.

en-US.title: Rain in Three Sizes
en-US.text: [curious] Rain comes in three sizes. Listen. {canvas:rain 0.7 20s} {sfx:rain} First comes the tiny rain. Tick… tick… tick… so small the flower {flower:pulse} does not even close her petals. Then comes the medium rain. Pitter-patter, pitter-patter, on every leaf of the tree. {tree:wobble x2} Then comes the BIG rain. Drum drum drum on the mushroom's cap! {mushroom:wobble x3} The frog {frog:hop x3} jumps for joy. {sfx:splash} SPLASH! Every hole in the ground fills up. One puddle. Two puddles. Three puddles, four! The forest drinks and drinks until the cloud is empty. And then… {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} the sun comes out to see what happened. It shines on puddle one, and drinks it up. It shines on puddle two, and drinks it up. Puddle three, puddle four… gone, gone. [happily] All that is left is one small, shining drop on the tip of the flower. Just enough for the frog.

es-ES.title: Lluvia de tres tamaños
es-ES.text: [curious] La lluvia viene en tres tamaños. Escuchad. {canvas:rain 0.7 20s} {sfx:rain} Primero llega la lluvia pequeñita. Tic… tic… tic… tan pequeña que la flor {flower:pulse} ni siquiera cierra los pétalos. Luego llega la lluvia mediana. Tip-tap, tip-tap, en cada hoja del árbol. {tree:wobble x2} Y luego llega la lluvia GRANDE. ¡Pom, pom, pom, en el sombrero de la seta! {mushroom:wobble x3} La rana {frog:hop x3} salta de alegría. {sfx:splash} ¡CHOF! Cada hueco del suelo se llena. Un charco. Dos charcos. Tres charcos, ¡cuatro! El bosque bebe y bebe hasta que la nube se queda vacía. Y entonces… {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} sale el sol a ver qué ha pasado. Brilla sobre el charco uno, y se lo bebe. Brilla sobre el charco dos, y se lo bebe. Charco tres, charco cuatro… adiós, adiós. [happily] Solo queda una gotita brillante en la punta de la flor. Justo para la rana.

rain.prompt: gentle rain on forest leaves, starting light and growing steady

splash.prompt: a small frog landing in a shallow puddle, one happy splash
